observed_facts: Tool 'search_docs' was called 3 times consecutively (steps 1-3) with equivalent input.
Every call returned an equivalent result.
findings.explanation: Back-to-back calls with the same input produced the same result each time, so the repetition made no measurable progress.
findings.likely_root_cause: Hypothesis: the agent has no retry limit and no rule for changing its input after an unchanged result. The trace shows the repetition, not why it happened.
alternative_explanations: The tool may be ignoring part of the input, so changing the input would not help either.
The call may be an intentional poll; if so, add the tool to the allow-list.
findings.recommended_action: Add a maximum retry limit for this tool and require the agent to change its input or stop after an unchanged result.

observed_facts: 'search_docs' returned an empty result at step 3.
'summarize' was then called at step 4 with an empty input value.
findings.explanation: The task was declared complete, but a later step ran on empty data, so its output is not grounded in retrieved evidence.
findings.likely_root_cause: Hypothesis: the workflow has no prerequisite requiring a non-empty retrieval before the next step.
alternative_explanations: The empty input may be a legitimate optional argument.
findings.recommended_action: Require a successful, non-empty retrieval before the dependent step, and require evidence before declaring completion.
